# xBRZ

The GBA "Smooth" look's filter: xBRZ by Zenju, a pixel-art scaler that keeps edges smooth and
clean without melting small details. These are the files of VBA-M's vectorised rework of xBRZ 1.9,
unchanged:

- Source: https://github.com/visualboyadvance-m/visualboyadvance-m, commit
  `b0ff7bd0449e4a433cee6ccb33444f7499ab5d20`, folder `src/components/filters/internal/xBRZ`
- Licence: GNU General Public License version 3 (see each file's header and `/LICENSE`), with
  Zenju's linking exception for MAME, FreeFileSync, Snes9x and ePSXe.
- Copyright (C) Zenju (zenju AT gmx DOT de); vectorisation by the VBA-M team.

Using it is why Project Prometheus's own code is under the GPL version 3 too (decision 0002).
